{{Top|leg}}
'''Overload spiral''' was a reference to the effects of shunting or diverting energy back from its power source. The word 'spiral' came from the [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] representation of a resulting mathematical function which was produced whenever the variables of time, shunted energy, and heat were plotted together.
